selected_engineering_route: sequence-strip-first complete chapter coverage in mature clear-line watercolor/cel-painted hybrid, followed by hash-exact panel-local causal repairs and sparse lettering-safe assembly

selection_basis.target_change: P001, P031, and P033 improve to PASS; P032 remains WARN
selection_basis.no_change_stability: 49/49 non-target panel hashes preserved in r2 and 47/47 in r3
selection_basis.continuity: Soren light-brown/dark-blond hair plus oatmeal coat and Sigrid dark tied hair plus plaid wrap remain visually stable across 32 cast panels
selection_basis.lettering: 20 sparse story beats; 8 canonical in-art placements and 12 outside-art gutters; no intentional face/person/important-hand/story-object obstruction

chapter_cadence.principle: Use large environmental/action/reversal anchors, medium character deduction and cooperation, and narrow object/sensory inserts; preserve narrative rhythm rather than enforcing one aspect ratio.

continuity_mechanism.minimum: Use only the three authorized fictional-adult references by role, repeat explicit adult/hair/wardrobe/cast assertions, generate coherent 3-5-panel sequences, then inspect the 32-cast-panel continuity sheet.
continuity_mechanism.repair_rule: When a panel misses one causal requirement, preserve the source strip and replace only the smallest panel set needed; do not regenerate the full chapter.
continuity_mechanism.known_limit: References improved continuity but the built-in product exposes no seed, model snapshot, endpoint, request ID, usage, or monetary cost; stochastic reproducibility remains unmeasured.

lettering_route.story_copy: Keep the r1 20-beat copy as review-only, not canon dialogue.
lettering_route.in_art: Use translucent backing only inside verified low-detail fields.
lettering_route.outside_art: Use gutters when canonical safe zones contain faces, bodies, hands, or clue objects.
lettering_route.action_and_inserts: Prefer silence or one short beat; never cover causal leverage, twine, maps, footprints, bells, or expressions.

remaining_warning_priority.issue: third upstream map mark is subtle
left-behind tin contents need clearer continuity
entry versus exterior-watch role separation is compressed

next_experiment: One single-panel P036 causal-leverage repair using the authorized P036 composition reference, followed by owner review of complete r3 rather than additional disconnected style probes.
limitations: All generated art and lettering remain provisional and unaccepted.
